title: Matthew Slade, Private Investigator
identity_notes: KPFK/Pacifica private-eye revival starring William Wintersole as Matthew Slade, also billed as Starlight Mystery Theatre. Frozen subset has eight recordings spanning confirmed 1964 originals, a 1965 rebroadcast identity, and one date-uncertain KPFK/KPFA aircheck.

historical_context.title: 1964 KPFK private-eye radio revival
historical_context.description: Matthew Slade revived private-eye radio drama at KPFK/Pacifica in 1964 under the Starlight Mystery Theatre banner.

historical_context.title: 1965-1968 repeat and service-syndication life
